20092.long_desc:
The Santa Treasure Fish Arcade Game is an oceanic video redemption game, which is available as an upgrade kit or in dedicated fish arcade machines! It features the famous Santa Claus and his reindeer in the game, as well as some familiar fishy characters with all new designs!

As with other fish hunting games, the concept is quite simple and straight forward, allowing for players of all skill levels to enter and enjoy the game. The Santa Treasure Fish Arcade Game is a race against the clock and your opponents, as players try to catch the most profitable characters within the stage time limit!
Santa Treasure Fish Arcade Game features include:

-Golden Time is a feature that upgrades the playersâ€™s weapon when they catch five Golden Sharks. The large golden weapon players receive is super powerful and only available for a limited time.

-Lucky Dice is a random feature that only affects certain fish and when players catch them it will grab all the other fish of the same kind and catch them for the player.

-Free Bullet Treasure Chest is a floating treasure chest that appears at random and it grants players free bullets when they manage to catch it.

-Treasure Genie is a feature that appears at random in the form of a floating treasure chest with the word â€˜Winningsâ€™ above it. Inside it a trapped genie that will be released when the player catches the chest!

With the exciting addition of the classic Santa Claus character, many of the medium and large fish characters in the game have received a major makeover, redesigned with armour style skin and fluro colours to help them stand out like never before!

The characters in the Santa Treasure Fish Arcade Game include Lionfish, Spearfish, Butterfly Fish, Lantern Fish, Turtles, Crabs, Fugu, Devilfish, Lobsters, Sharks, Octopus, Golden Sharks, Killer Whales, Whales, and more! There are over 20 fish characters in this game to try and catch.

The Santa Treasure Fish Arcade Game is available in a full upgrade kit, 6 player 32â€³ arcade cabinet, 6 player 58â€³ arcade cabinet, 8 player 58â€³ arcade cabinet, and a 10 player arcade cabinet with two 58â€³ monitors! These options give operators more choice to choose the products that work best for their location and customers!

To further this value for operators, the cabinets also come with a variety of input and output configurations, allowing operators to customize their machine to better suit the needs of their location.
